text: We are a manufacturer in Newcastle looking to automate order processing, shop-floor data capture, and operations without replacing our ERP. Which automation and Power Platform consultants should we speak to?

result.keyword: We are a manufacturer in Newcastle looking to automate order processing, shop-floor data capture, and operations without replacing our ERP. Which automation and Power Platform consultants should we speak to?

items.markdown:
For a manufacturer in Newcastle looking to layer automation and the Microsoft Power Platform over your existing ERP (rather than ripping and replacing it), you want `specialists who understand both local industrial operations and secure data integration architecture` (APIs, data gateways, and custom connectors).

The regional and specialist consulting options well-suited to handle shop-floor data capture, order processing, and workflow automation without disrupting your core ERP include:

- [WorkflowIQ](https://workflowiq.com.au/power-platform/) – **Local Newcastle-based specialists** focusing heavily on Microsoft 365, Power Automate, Power Apps, and compliance management systems. They excel at practical business process improvement and bridging gaps in operational efficiency without heavy-handed enterprise overhauls.[[1]](https://workflowiq.com.au/contact/)[[2]](https://workflowiq.com.au/power-platform/)[[3]](https://workflowiq.com.au/about/)
- [Cloudhunter](https://cloudhunter.com.au/) – **Regional Microsoft Cloud Partners** based nearby on the Central Coast and actively servicing Newcastle and the Hunter Valley. They specialize in Power Platform, Azure integrations, SharePoint OCR/document automation, and connecting data layers alongside existing operational systems.[[1]](https://cloudhunter.com.au/)
- [Inturing](https://www.inturing.com.au/manufacturing) – **Australian-wide manufacturing-focused Power Platform specialists** who explicitly design integration patterns between the Power Platform and existing shop-floor infrastructure, MES, or legacy ERP systems via custom APIs and gateways. They build tailored shop-floor mobile/tablet Power Apps and automated production reporting systems.[[1]](https://www.inturing.com.au/manufacturing)

If you'd like to narrow this down, please let me know:

- What **ERP system** are you currently running?
- Is the shop-floor data capture primarily **tablet/mobile-based** or hardware/barcode integrated?

I can help outline a **targeted scoping checklist** or specific integration questions to ask these consultants.
